description: This file defines an asynchronous function `runCallsiteGuard` that orchestrates scanning TypeScript source files for specific call sites, applying filtering rules, and reporting violations. It utilizes external utility functions for file collection and path resolution, performs file reading, and logs violations to the console.

methods.name: runCallsiteGuard
methods.description: Asynchronous function that scans project files for specified call sites, applies filters, and outputs violations.
